questions.prompt: Before the validation auditor arrived in the hybrid multi-cloud environment, the cloud infrastructure architect noticed that the Microsoft Entra ID privileged identity role _____.

explanations.correct: Past Perfect Passive ('had been enforced') expresses an action completed prior to the past event 'arrived'.
explanations.wrong_A: Past Simple ('was enforced') fails to indicate precedence before past 'arrived'.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Perfect ('has been enforced') cannot anchor to a past narrative.
explanations.wrong_D: Active negative is wrong in voice; technical equipment is acted upon passively.

questions.cz_learning_point: V angličtině vyžaduje děj předcházející jinému ději v minulosti předminulý čas (Past Perfect: 'had been...').
questions.workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation

questions.prompt: If the operating parameter _____ above safe limits, the automated system immediately halts the cycle.

explanations.correct: First conditional if-clause requires Present Simple ('rises') for real operating conditions.
explanations.wrong_A: Cannot use future modal 'will' inside the conditional if-clause.
explanations.wrong_B: Cannot use 'would' in a real First Conditional.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'rose' creates an unreal conditional mismatched with present 'halts'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Zásadní pravidlo: v podmínkové větě po 'if' se nesmí použít 'will' (*If the parameter will rise* je hrubá chyba). Použijte přítomný čas: 'If the parameter rises'.
questions.workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation

questions.prompt: The maintenance specialist detected an irregular vibration _____ the equipment was running at maximum speed.

explanations.correct: 'While' is a conjunction followed by a full finite clause ('the equipment was running').
explanations.wrong_B: 'During' is a preposition and can only be followed by a noun phrase, never a clause with a verb.
explanations.wrong_C: 'For' expresses duration, not simultaneous background events.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Since' indicates a starting point in time or causation.

questions.cz_learning_point: Češi často pletou 'during' a 'while'. S celou větou se slovesem se pojí 'while' (while it was running), zatímco se samotným podstatným jménem se pojí 'during' (during the run).
questions.workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation

questions.prompt: According to GDPR Article 32 technical security controls, the SAP S/4HANA enterprise database instance _____ at regular 500-hour operational intervals.

explanations.correct: Passive with modal: 'must be migrated' correctly describes the technical maintenance requirement.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modal 'must' takes bare infinitive.
explanations.wrong_B: Active voice is incorrect; equipment cannot service itself.
explanations.wrong_C: 'are must' is completely ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Technické předpisy (SOP) vyžadují trpný rod se způsobovým slovesem: 'must be inspected' (musí být zkontrolováno).
questions.workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation

questions.prompt: The engineering department _____ three comprehensive compliance audits since the beginning of this quarter.

explanations.correct: Time frame indicator 'since the beginning of this quarter' requires Present Perfect ('has conducted').
explanations.wrong_A: Past Simple cannot co-occur with 'since' connecting past to present.
explanations.wrong_B: Present Continuous expresses action in progress, not completed tally.
explanations.wrong_D: Present Simple expresses habitual routines, not accumulated achievements.

questions.cz_learning_point: Předložka 'since' (od té doby) striktně vyžaduje předpřítomný čas (Present Perfect: 'has conducted'), protože časové období pokračuje do přítomnosti.
questions.workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation

questions.prompt: The parameters were recalibrated _____ the manufacturing line could achieve zero defect tolerance.

explanations.correct: 'So that' is a conjunction of purpose followed by a subject and modal verb clause ('the line could achieve').
explanations.wrong_C: 'because of' is followed by a noun phrase, not a clause with a finite verb.
explanations.wrong_D: 'for to' is completely ungrammatical in standard English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Účelová spojka 'so that' = aby (následovaná celou větou: 'so that the line could achieve').
questions.workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation

questions.prompt: In the event of an unexpected pressure drop, the emergency system will _____ the main intake manifold.

explanations.correct: Phrasal verb 'shut down' correctly means to halt or power off an operating mechanical system.
explanations.wrong_A: 'shut off to' is an ungrammatical combination.
explanations.wrong_B: Participle 'shutting down' cannot follow future auxiliary 'will'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'shut down of' includes an unnecessary, ungrammatical preposition.

questions.cz_learning_point: Frázové sloveso 'shut down' (odstavit / vypnout zařízení). Po pomocném slovesu 'will' následuje základní tvar: 'will shut down'.
questions.workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation

questions.prompt: The newly installed sensor, _____ measurement tolerance is within 0.01 mm, was imported from Germany.

explanations.correct: Possessive relative pronoun 'whose' correctly links the antecedent 'sensor' with its attribute 'measurement tolerance'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'that' cannot be used in non-defining relative clauses set off by commas.
explanations.wrong_D: 'of which' would require different word order ('the measurement tolerance of which').

questions.cz_learning_point: Přivlastňovací vztažné zájmeno 'whose' (jehož / jejíž tolerance) se v angličtině používá i pro neživé předměty a stroje.
questions.workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation

questions.prompt: The pressure gauge reads zero despite the compressor running, so the main seal _____ cracked.

explanations.correct: 'Must be' expresses logical deduction based on clear physical evidence.
explanations.wrong_B: 'can to be' is ungrammatical; modals never take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Logická dedukce (určitě je / musí být poškozeno): 'must be cracked'. Nikdy nepoužívejte *must to be*.
questions.workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation

questions.prompt: The production line cannot resume operation _____ the safety interlock circuit is fully reset.

explanations.correct: 'Unless' means 'if not' or 'except when', expressing the mandatory prerequisite for resumption.
explanations.wrong_A: 'if' would produce an illogical contradiction (cannot run IF reset).
explanations.wrong_C: 'provided that' creates the opposite, illogical meaning.
explanations.wrong_D: 'as long as' also creates an illogical condition.

questions.cz_learning_point: 'Unless' znamená 'pokud ne' (if not). Po 'unless' už v anglické větě nenásleduje další zápor: 'unless the circuit is reset'.
questions.workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation
